The structure of Dy(Al3O4)2 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4_1/acd (No. 143), with a 36-atom unit cell (Dy4Al12O16) and six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers in octahedral environments with six O neighbors, Dy centers in close-packed-like 12-neighbor arrangements, and O centers in square-pyramidal coordination. Al-centered octahedra share corners and edges with one another and corners with square-pyramidal O polyhedra, while Dy 12-vertex polyhedra share faces with both Al octahedra and O square pyramids. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
